effects.before: After computing total_baseline (total_spans - total_outliers), execution always continued into building/logging compare_distributions params, calling compare_distributions (Seer), and processing rrr_results; the ranked_distribution response dict was only constructed after that processing, right before the results loop that fills rankedAttributes.
effects.after: The ranked_distribution response dict (rankedAttributes=[], rankingInfo, cohort1Total, cohort2Total) is built immediately after total_baseline is computed. If total_baseline <= 0, a warning is logged ("total_baseline is <= 0 (%s). Returning empty response") and the endpoint returns that ranked_distribution immediately, skipping the compare_distributions call, the Seer request, and the rrr_results loop entirely.

side_effects: The ranked_distribution dict construction was relocated from just before the rrr_results loop (old location, right after compare_distributions/Seer scoring) to immediately after total_baseline is computed, before the compare_distributions logger.info call and before compare_distributions is invoked.
